interpretation.name: TightenVariantFastenersWithSharedNutrunner
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 to the station of line 4 and tighten the fasteners of the line-4 variant using the variant's MES tightening program. This cannot be resolved because line 4 does not exist in the runtime plant state, which knows only lines 1, 2 and 3.
constraints: Unresolved scope: line 4 is not in the runtime plant state (only lines 1, 2 and 3 exist), so its station and variant are unknown and must not be guessed; the operator must confirm or correct the line number
E1: NR7 must be reserved with reserve-tool before use and released with release-tool afterwards
E2: transport-tool Steps must set executor = agvexecutor
E3: NR7 must be at the station before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners is invoked
E4: The tightening program must be obtained only through get-program, with no torque or tolerance literals in the Recipe
E5: Every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability
E6: Every tool-using Step must depend on the reserve-tool Step, because it renews the lease with the reservation token
E9: Every single tool-using Step must finish within the 120 s tool lease

findings.message: all requested capabilities are grounded in sigma_i
